O'Brien, S.J. Library is the Information Resource Center of the University. It exists to support the academic and research activities of the University. It likewise welcomes the opportunity of serving other institutions in the province
                                and the region within the limits of its resources. The 3-storey building has a total floor area of 3,600 square meters and a shelving capacity of up to 100,000 volumes. It can seat up to 600 users. The college and the graduate
                                school collections are housed in this place. Mission The James O' Brien, S.J. Library exists primarily to serve the teaching, research, curricular and extension programs of the university through organized, relevant, accessible and efficient information services. Vision Towards excellent and competitive services, Ateneo de Naga University Library, in support of teaching, learning, and research provides links between print and electronic information sources for systematic access to accurate and efficient retrieval of
                                materials; more active role for competent librarians with an opportunity for quality integrated library services through modern library facilities and technical innovations. As a new semester begins, your library is thrilled to open its doors and host the Welcome Fest & Information Fair (Year 3) from July 27 to August 28, 2026! Whether you’re a fresh face on campus or a returning student, faculty, or staff member, we’re here to help you search, discover, and explore. 💙 💡 What will you learn & achieve? ✅ Explore Service Points: Know where to go—from the Circulation Desk and Electronic Resource Center to our dedicated Multimedia and Study Areas ✅ Master the OPAC: Easily locate physical
                                                                books, check call numbers, verify item availability in real time, and navigate the shelves like a pro. ✅ Know the Policies: Get clear on borrowing privileges, return protocols, loan periods,
                                                                and study zone guidelines. ✅ Go Digital: Gain confidence in navigating our online platforms to access e-books, databases, and digital services independently from anywhere! 🗓️
                                                                Dates: July 27 – August 28, 2026 📍 Location: University Library Drop by, take a tour, ask questions, and discover how the library can be your ultimate partner this semester.
